description: Job Title: Project Controls Analyst Job Description We are seeking a Project Controls Analyst to support capital projects and turnaround activities by consolidating project cost data from multiple sources into accurate, standardized, and actionable reports. This individual will work closely with project managers, cost engineers, planners, schedulers, and other stakeholders to improve the flow of project data, streamline reporting processes, and provide clear visibility into project costs, forecasts, commitments, and variances. Responsibilities Consolidate project cost data from various sources into standardized reports. Collaborate with project managers, cost engineers, planners, and schedulers to enhance project data flow. Streamline reporting processes to ensure clarity and precision. Provide detailed visibility into project costs, forecasts, commitments, and variances. Support risk and change management efforts. Drive improvements in the handling and reporting of cost information. Essential Skills Proficiency in cost control and cost analysis. Experience with forecasting and analyzing cost variances. Ability to align cost structures with execution plans. Strong data integration skills. Knowledge of EcoSys, Power BI, and Primavera 6. Additional Skills & Qualifications Experience in developing cost forecasts. Capability to improve data integrity. Using integrated systems and data to analyze project performance. Work Environment The work environment involves collaboration with various stakeholders using advanced technologies such as EcoSys, Power BI, and Primavera 6. The role requires attention to detail and strong analytical skills to support capital projects and turnaround activities. Job Type & Location This is a Contract position based out of Wichita, KS. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $60.00 - $70.00/hr. Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors. Job Title: Analyst, Quality Control Job Description We are seeking a motivated Quality Control (QC) Analyst to join our dynamic QC Microbiology team. This role offers an opportunity to influence the culture and operations of an early-phase QC group while collaborating across functions in a start-up environment. The position is based in Louisville, CO. Responsibilities Demonstrate company values as part of a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative organization. Perform routine Quality Control laboratory work, including environmental monitoring, clean utility sampling and testing, microbiological material qualification and maintenance, microbial identification, raw material sampling and inspection, bioburden testing, endotoxin testing, compendial testing, and container closure integrity testing. Follow established Quality Control procedures and maintain proficiency in applicable laboratory methods, systems, and processes. Document laboratory activities in accordance with applicable procedures and cGMP requirements. Apply Operational Excellence/LEAN philosophy within QC laboratories for continuous improvement across all programs, processes, and systems. Prepare, ship, and track samples to outside testing laboratories. Perform additional duties within the Quality organization as required. Essential Skills Bachelors degree in Biochemistry, Molecular and Cellular Biology, Immunology, Biology, or other life science. 0+ years of experience working in a cGMP regulated QC environment. Passion for teamwork and commitment to purpose, team success, and an outstanding workplace culture. Ability to work on-site 5 days per week and ability to work evenings and/or weekends as needed. Additional Skills & Qualifications Self-motivated with strong time management skills and ability to work independently. Proficient computer skills and experience using MS Office applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). Commitment to continuous learning and development of laboratory expertise. Ability to aseptically gown and work while standing for extended periods in cleanrooms. Ability to regularly lift 20 lbs. and periodically lift up to 50 lbs. Desire for continuous self-development and process improvement. Work Environment The work environment promotes work-life balance with core hours from Monday to Friday, 9 am to 4 pm, and flexibility in scheduling around core hours. One day per month may require a longer shift from 12 pm to 9 pm. The culture is collaborative, emphasizing good communication and proactive work. Integrity and thoughtful work practices are prioritized, ensuring a supportive and innovative workplace. Job Type & Location This is a Contract position based out of Louisville, CO. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $26.92 - $33.17/hr. Job Title: Senior Analyst Support / Lab Lead (Business Analyst) Job Description This role serves as a Senior Analyst Support / Lab Lead within a systems integration and test environment, managing and implementing environmental test projects while overseeing the day-to-day administrative functions of multiple engineering and environmental test laboratories. The position focuses on maintaining safety, security, and compliance in accordance with established policies, procedures, and governance. You apply creativity and innovation to improve lab operations and possess strong organizational, coordination, planning, analytical, and problem-solving skills. You collaborate closely with customers, employees, and Senior leaders when implementing process and procedural changes to support efficient, safe, and compliant lab activities. Responsibilities Support Lab Operating Procedures by sharing guidelines and information with lab users to ensure consistent and compliant lab practices. Assist with basic Environmental Health and Safety tasks and general sustainment activities to maintain a safe and orderly lab environment. Help with routine property tracking and manage simple equipment check-ins or updates to keep asset records accurate and current. Support basic cost tracking activities and help ensure tasks and projects remain within general budget expectations. Provide general support to Supply Chain Management, including coordination of materials, equipment, and lab-related supplies as needed. Prepare materials and documentation for audits or assessments to demonstrate compliance with safety, security, and quality standards. Assist with simple lab evaluations and follow up on improvements identified by the engineering team to enhance lab performance and reliability. Follow security and material-handling guidelines for controlled items and documentation to protect sensitive information and equipment. Share updates and general communications with teams and support managers with routine coordination tasks to keep stakeholders informed. Work collaboratively with team members to follow established policies and procedures and promote a culture of safety and compliance. Carry out tasks under regular supervision, seeking guidance when needed to ensure work quality and adherence to standards. Perform duties that may involve standing, walking, or occasional work outdoors as required by lab and test activities. Essential Skills University degree or equivalent experience, typically with at least 2 years of relevant work experience. Experience working with engineers, technicians, or team leads in a lab or technical environment. Basic mechanical skills and fundamental electrical or electronic aptitude applicable to lab equipment and test setups. Familiarity with basic workplace safety guidelines and the ability to apply them in a lab setting. Experience supporting teams in areas such as safety, security, compliance, or property handling. Exposure to Environmental Health

Job Title: IT Business Systems Analyst MRO, Service & Asset Management Job Description The IT Business Systems Analyst serves as a strategic liaison between business functions and IT, focusing on maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), service management, inventory and warehouse management, and asset maintenance operations. Working with minimal supervision, this role designs, optimizes, and supports the implementation of business processes and enterprise IT solutions across the maintenance lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings deep, hands-on experience in maintenance and service operations and understands how these processes are enabled through ERP and related enterprise applications. Responsibilities Understand the full landscape of applications that support assigned business functions and departments, and how they interact across the maintenance lifecycle. Analyze business requests across the four pillars of business analysis, evaluating their validity, alignment with existing processes and systems, business criticality, estimated return on investment, and best-practice solution options. Author clear and accurate as-is business process diagrams, such as swimlane flows, to interpret business process requirements and IT change requests. Apply a strong understanding of end-to-end MRO and maintenance processes, including work identification and intake, work planning and scheduling, preventive and corrective maintenance, inspection and repair, work execution and closure, asset and component tracking, parts and materials coordination, labor and resource management, and maintenance history and records management. Develop solution proposal documents in multiple formats, including presentations, spreadsheets, written narratives, and to-be process diagrams, while considering cost, feasibility, level of effort, and compliance requirements. Create detailed functional specification documents for technical development teams to ensure accurate and efficient solution delivery. Perform unit testing and functional acceptance testing of solutions developed by functional analysts and technical development teams to verify alignment with requirements. Coordinate and facilitate user acceptance testing of application changes, ensuring stakeholders validate and approve solutions before deployment to production. Understand standard software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes and be willing to learn and operate within specific SDLC and application change request/approval workflows using systems such as ServiceNow. Apply a high-level understanding of IT project management frameworks, including waterfall and agile, and manage small to mid-size IT projects with guidance from leadership, business operations, the project management office, and IT finance. Job Title: Industrial Engineering Analytics Engineer Location: Long term will be located in Austin, TX (first 2-3 months will be traveling/working onsite in Pittsburg, PA for training) Job Description The Industrial Engineering Analytics Engineer leads the development and application of advanced analytical models to improve manufacturing efficiency, capacity planning, and cost optimization in large-scale production environments. This role builds and manages integrated industrial engineering models that connect capacity, labor, material flow, and cost of goods sold to enable data-driven decision-making across factory and site operations. The position combines strong industrial engineering fundamentals with advanced analytics, simulation, business case development, and AI-driven systems to support both tactical and strategic manufacturing decisions. Responsibilities Develop and own integrated industrial engineering models that connect capacity, labor, material flow, and cost of goods sold to support factory planning and operations. Build and maintain capacity models that compare target, forecast, and gated capacity, incorporating cycle time, overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), yield losses, and bottleneck analysis. Develop labor models to optimize headcount, utilization, and labor cost across production systems. Create and evaluate business cases for capital investments, including ROI, IRR, NPV, and detailed cost-benefit analysis. Lead cost of goods sold (COGS) modeling, including labor, overhead, scrap, and process-driven cost components. Develop and track scrap and yield models, quantify cost impact, and identify opportunities for improvement. Design and maintain OEE models that capture availability, performance, and quality to drive operational efficiency and continuous improvement. Support factory layout, site planning, and material flow decisions through data-driven insights and modeling. Perform scenario analysis and sensitivity studies to evaluate production strategies and capacity expansion plans. Utilize and develop factory simulation models (such as FlexSim, AnyLogic, and similar tools) to analyze throughput, bottlenecks, and overall system performance. Support factory ramp-up, equipment installation, and operational readiness through model validation and performance tracking. Collaborate with manufacturing, operations, supply chain, finance, and engineering teams to align models with real-world constraints and business needs. Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, executive-level insights and recommendations for senior stakeholders. Work closely with MES and controls teams to integrate shop-floor data with industrial engineering models, ensuring accurate OEE measurement and enabling real-time, scalable dashboards for operational visibility and executive decision-making. Introduce and implement AI-driven tools and platforms to enhance industrial engineering analytics and decision-making. Design and manage scalable data models

Biochemist - QC Specialist Job Description The QC Specialist leads day-to-day quality control laboratory activities, serving as the primary technical resource for technicians and other specialists. This role performs routine release testing, drives method development and validation efforts, and supports technical transfers to ensure robust and compliant analytical practices. The QC Specialist acts as a subject matter expert on key laboratory equipment, leads quality events and investigations, and partners with leadership to optimize processes and uphold a culture of safety, compliance, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Direct the daily workload of QC Technicians and other Specialists, ensuring that quality control policies, procedures, and standards are consistently followed. Serve as the primary point of contact for technical instruction, clarification, and troubleshooting for the QC team. Perform regular release testing to support product and material disposition in accordance with established methods and specifications. Lead and execute specialized development experiments, including method development, optimization, and improvement activities. Participate in and, when appropriate, own method validation activities to ensure analytical methods are robust, reliable, and compliant. Support and lead technical transfers of analytical methods, ensuring smooth implementation and proper documentation across laboratories or functions. Regularly lead and own quality events such as deviations, laboratory investigations, and change activities, ensuring timely, thorough, and well-documented resolutions. Review and approve documentation generated by QC Technicians and other Specialists, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with procedures. Audit inventory management practices in the laboratory to ensure reagents and materials are properly controlled, labeled, and stored. Ensure reagent and material qualifications are maintained, including monitoring expiration dates, qualification status, and usage. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for specialized laboratory equipment, providing guidance on proper use and troubleshooting. Coordinate routine maintenance schedules and calibration activities for critical laboratory instruments to ensure readiness and compliance. Ensure laboratory equipment and systems remain in a state of control and meet regulatory and internal quality expectations. Partner with the QC Leader to identify obsolete or inefficient processes and propose improvements to enhance laboratory systems and workflows. Anticipate potential problems in QC processes and proactively develop effective solutions to prevent issues and improve efficiency. Participate in internal and external audit activities, representing QC operations and providing accurate and timely information to auditors. Job Title: Quality Control Analyst Job Description The Quality Control Analyst will perform routine and non-routine laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products to ensure compliance with quality specifications. This role is vital in maintaining the integrity and safety of products through meticulous testing and documentation. Responsibilities Conduct routine and non-routine laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products. Perform Ph and moisture testing, density measurements, chemical titrations, and allergen testing. Monitor critical control points and support food safety programs. Review and document test results, investigate out-of-specification findings, and support root cause analysis and corrective actions. Collaborate with production and operations teams to ensure quality standards are maintained throughout the manufacturing process. Maintain accurate and compliant documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Assist with internal and external audits, including customer, regulatory, and third-party inspections. Support continuous improvement initiatives related to product quality, food safety, and process efficiency. Calibrate and maintain laboratory equipment to ensure accuracy and reliability of results. Participate in training programs to promote quality awareness and compliance across the facility. Essential Skills Proficiency in quality assurance and quality control practices. Experience in a laboratory environment. Knowledge of FDA and USDA regulations. Ability to conduct various laboratory tests such as Ph, moisture testing, density measurements, and chemical titrations. Additional Skills & Qualifications Bachelors degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or a related scientific field is preferred but not required. Work Environment This role operates in both laboratory and manufacturing environments, requiring work around food processing equipment and varying temperatures. The position follows an overnight shift with a 2/2/3 schedule from 6PM-6AM. Job Type & Location This is a Contract to Hire position based out of South Sioux City, NE. Role Overview
The EDI Analyst acts as the organization’s internal subject matter expert, working with internal and external customers to ensure desired outcomes for EDI projects and requests. This is a customer-facing role with heavy email and ticket volume, requiring a self-starter who is comfortable with a high-volume, fast-turnaround environment. The position involves requirements gathering, mapping, transaction setup, and implementation.

Experience in check processing domains is beneficial for understanding financial transaction risks and ensuring secure compliant operations. Responsibilities Assess enterprise technology environments to identify cyber risks and control gaps applying risk management practices to prioritize remediation efforts that protect critical systems and data. Develop and maintain comprehensive risk registers that clearly document vulnerabilities threat scenarios impact ratings and mitigation plans to support transparent risk decisions by stakeholders. Conduct detailed risk assessments for new and existing applications infrastructure changes and third party services to ensure cyber risk is evaluated before deployment or integration. Collaborate with security engineering and operations teams to define practical risk reduction actions translate findings into clear requirements and ensure mitigation steps align with business needs. Monitor security alerts risk indicators and incident trends to detect emerging risk patterns and provide timely recommendations that strengthen defenses and reduce recurrence. Coordinate periodic control testing and validation activities to verify that implemented risk treatments are effective measurable and aligned with internal standards and regulatory obligations. Prepare concise risk reports and dashboards for management that highlight key risk drivers residual exposure levels and the progress of remediation initiatives across technology domains. Support policy and standard development by providing input based on observed risks and incidents ensuring that documented expectations are practical and aligned with recognized security frameworks. Advise project teams during system design and change initiatives to embed appropriate security controls ensuring risk considerations are addressed early and reducing the need for costly rework. Engage with business stakeholders to explain cyber risk in clear terms enabling informed decisions that balance protective measures with operational efficiency and customer impact. Apply knowledge of payment and transaction flows especially in check processing environments to identify fraud and operational risks and propose control enhancements that secure financial operations. Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting lessons learned from assessments and near miss events recommending updates to risk methodologies tools and processes for better outcomes. Maintain accurate and current documentation of risk management activities methodologies and outcomes to support audits compliance reviews and organizational learning. Qualifications Demonstrate five to sev

About the role As a Data and Machine Learning Engineer , you will make an impact by designing, building, and optimizing scalable data platforms and machine learning solutions within a Microsoft Azure environment. You will be a valued member of the Data Engineering team and work collaboratively with data scientists, cloud engineers, architects, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and production-ready solutions. In this role, you will: Design, develop, and maintain scalable data ingestion, transformation, and ETL/ELT pipelines. Build and optimize Azure-based data platforms using Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Data Lake, and related cloud technologies. Deploy, operationalize, and support machine learning solutions through CI/CD pipelines and MLOps practices. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data and machine learning workloads to ensure performance, reliability, and scalability. Collaborate with engineering and data science teams to translate business and technical requirements into production-ready solutions. Work model At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Mason, Ohio. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered Proven experience as a Data Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, or Cloud Platform Engineer. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure data engineering and analytics services. Proficiency in Python, SQL, and/or Scala. Experience developing, supporting, and optimizing production-grade data pipelines. Hands-on experience with Apache Spark, Databricks, or comparable distributed data processing frameworks. Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and MLOps practices. Ability to independently design, develop, troubleshoot, and deliver technical solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills with experience working across cross-functional teams. These will help you stand out: Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, and Azure Data Lake. Knowledge of MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Experience with Delta Lake, Parquet, and modern cloud data architectures. Familiarity with infrastructure as code, orchestration frameworks, and cloud monitoring tools. Exposure to enterprise data integrations, including SAP Change Data Capture (CDC). Experience working in Agile development environments. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. job_title: French Digital Marketing Campaign Analyst (Paid Media & Video Streaming)
description: French Digital Marketing Campaign Analyst (Paid Media & Video Streaming) Join a dynamic team supporting global advertisers in the planning, execution, optimization, and reporting of high-impact digital advertising campaigns. As a Digital Marketing Campaign Analyst, you will work closely with Account Managers and Campaign Managers to drive campaign performance across video streaming platform advertising, demand generation, paid search, display and creator partnership initiatives. You will be responsible for monitoring campaign performance, optimizing targeting and bidding strategies, analyzing data-driven insights, ensuring brand safety compliance, and delivering actionable recommendations that help clients achieve their business objectives and growth targets. The role also includes supporting creator partnerships, evaluating content for compliance, identifying growth opportunities, and producing performance reports that demonstrate campaign success. Key Responsibilities Optimize and manage video streaming platform campaigns, creator profiles on video platforms, paid search, display and Demand Gen campaigns. Conduct creator content reviews, brand safety checks, and compliance assessments. Monitor budgets, pacing, and KPI performance to maximize campaign results. Analyze campaign data and provide strategic recommendations to improve performance. Support campaign setup, keyword management, targeting strategies, and ad operations. Generate performance reports and deliver actionable insights to stakeholders. Collaborate with global teams to identify growth opportunities and drive client success. Stay current with industry trends, advertising technologies, and AI-driven marketing tools. Requirements 1.5years of experience in digital marketing, paid media, SEM/PPC, Google Ads, display advertising, video advertising, account management, or customer-facing campaign support. Strong understanding of online advertising channels, campaign optimization, and performance marketing metrics. Hands-on experience with Google Ads and video streaming platform advertising. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables and complex formulas. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication abilities. Experience working with international clients and cross-functional global teams. Fluent English and French communication skills, both written and verbal. Offer: Pleasant and inspiring working atmosphere; Opportunity to be part of a rapidly expanding global organization; Office facilities in a convenient location in Lisbon; Training & development opportunities; Relocation allowance & relocation support (For candidates moving from abroad).

Role: Gen AI Engineer Experience: 6 to 15 Years Location: Pan India Notice Period: Immediate to 90 days Mode of Interview: In-Person Job Description: Collect and prepare data for training and evaluating multimodal foundation models. This may involve cleaning and processing text data or creating synthetic data. Develop and optimize large-scale language models like GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks) and VAEs (Variational Autoencoders) Work on tasks involving language modeling, text generation, understanding, and contextual comprehension. Regularly review and fine-tune Large Language models to ensure maximum accuracy and relevance for custom datasets. Build and deploy AI applications on cloud platforms – any hyperscaler Azure, GCP or AWS. Integrate AI models with our company's data to enhance and augment existing applications. Role & Responsibility Handle data preprocessing, augmentation, and generation of synthetic data. Design and develop backend services using Python or .NET to support OpenAI-powered solutions (or any other LLM solution) Develop and Maintaining AI Pipelines Work with custom datasets, utilizing techniques like chunking and embeddings, to train and fine-tune models. Integrate Azure cognitive services (or equivalent platform services) to extend functionality and improve AI solutions Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth deployment and integration of AI solutions. Ensure the robustness, efficiency, and scalability of AI systems. Stay updated with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning technologies. Skills & Experience · Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and computer science. · Expertise in generative AI models and techniques (e.g., GANs, VAEs, Transformers). · Experience with natural language processing (NLP) and computer vision is a plus. · Ability to work independently and as part of a team. · Knowledge of advanced programming like Python, and especially AI-centric libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras. This includes the ability to implement and manipulate complex algorithms fundamental to developing generative AI models. · Knowledge of Natural language processing (NLP) for text generation projects like text parsing, sentiment analysis, and the use of transformers like GPT (generative pre-trained transformer) models. · Experience in Data management, including data pre-processing, augmentation, and generation of synthetic data. This involves cleaning, labeling, and augmenting data to train and improve AI models. · Experience in developing and deploying AI models in production environments. Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding of containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes for deploying , managing and scaling AI solutions Should be able to bring new ideas and innovative solutions to our clients

Knowledge of cloud services (AWS, Azure, GCP) and understanding of containerization technologies like Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes for deploying , managing and scaling AI solutions Should be able to bring new ideas and innovative solutions to our clients

As a Senior / Lead GenAI Engineer, you will design, build and scale production-grade Generative AI solutions for a leading company in the banking sector, taking technical ownership from architecture through deployment, in a fully remote role. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior / Lead GenAI Engineer with deep, hands-on expertise in Python and Large Language Models to design, build and scale Generative AI solutions for a leading banking sector client. In this role, you will take technical ownership of GenAI initiatives end-to-end — from architecture and prototyping through to secure, compliant production deployment — while mentoring engineers and partnering with business, risk and compliance stakeholders to ensure solutions meet the standards of a highly regulated environment. Leadership & Stakeholder Management ● Act as technical lead for GenAI initiatives, mentoring engineers and setting technical direction. ● Translate business requirements from banking stakeholders (risk, compliance, customer experience) into robust technical solutions. ● Partner with architecture, security and compliance teams to ensure GenAI solutions meet the regulatory standards of the banking sector. REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE ● 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with significant hands-on experience building Generative AI / LLM-based solutions in production. ● Expert-level Python skills, including experience with modern GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex or equivalent). ● Deep understanding of LLM concepts: RAG architectures, embeddings, prompt engineering, fine-tuning and evaluation methodologies. ● Hands-on experience integrating LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) into production systems. ● Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, OpenSearch, FAISS, Weaviate) and embedding optimization. ● Solid cloud experience (AWS, Azure or GCP) for deploying and scaling AI workloads. ● Strong understanding of data secu

Role Overview Cognizant is seeking an accomplished Lead Full Stack AI Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale AI solutions powered by AWS cloud technologies, Generative AI, and Agentic AI frameworks. The successful candidate will lead the delivery of scalable, secure, reliable, and cost-optimized AI applications while driving engineering best practices and mentoring development teams. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience building LLM-powered applications, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, agentic workflows, cloud-native architectures, and enterprise-scale AI platforms. Work Model This position follows a hybrid work model based in New Jersey . Candidates local to New Jersey are strongly preferred and should be available to work onsite as required by client and business needs. Translate business requirements into technical architectures and implementation plans. Drive solution design decisions balancing scalability, maintainability, performance, security, and cost optimization. We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence initiatives. Working closely with business stakeholders, analysts, and technical teams, you will develop end-to-end data pipelines and analytics-ready datasets using Microsoft Fabric. You will play a key role in ensuring data solutions are reliable, secure, high-performing, and aligned with governance standards while delivering value within an Agile environment. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain data solutions using Microsoft Fabric . Build and optimize end-to-end data ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines. Develop and manage Fabric Dataflows, Lakehouses, and Warehouses . Create analytics-ready datasets that support reporting and business insights. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable data solutions. Ensure data quality, reliability, governance, and accessibility across the platform. Optimize platform performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Required Experience & Skills Proven experience delivering data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric . Strong expertise in: Data Pipelines, Dataflows, Lakehouse, and Warehouse architecture ETL/ELT design and implementation Data modelling, including dimensional modelling and star schema design Large-scale data processing and analytics environments Advanced SQL skills and experience with Python and Spark for data transformation. Experience with Azure data services, including: Azure Data Factory Azure Synapse Analytics Azure Data Lake Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to deliver high-quality solutions within Agile delivery teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience within financial services or other regulated industries. Knowledge of data governance, security, and performance optimization best practices. Microsoft Fabric or Azure data certifications. What We're Looking For A hands-on Data Engineer who combines strong technical expertise with a business-focused mindset. You are passionate about building scalable, well-governed data solutions and have a proven ability to deliver reliable, high-quality outcomes in fast-paced Agile environments. #LI-1_MS1

As a Payroll Analyst , you will make an impact by ensuring accurate, compliant, and efficient payroll operations for a large multinational client within the Offshore Oil & Gas industry. You will be a valued member of the Payroll team and work collaboratively with internal stakeholders, client contacts, finance teams, and HR professionals to deliver high-quality payroll services and support complex payroll scenarios. In this role, you will: Execute end-to-end payroll processing, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and adherence to established deadlines. Manage payroll activities within TOTVS RM, including payroll inputs, validations, reconciliations, and payroll closing routines. Administer and validate payroll taxes, statutory obligations, eSocial activities, and payroll-related account reconciliations. Support offshore payroll processes, including embarkation allowances, expatriate and impatriate payroll requirements, and Shadow Payroll calculations. Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to resolve payroll issues, manage risks, ensure compliance, and provide a high level of customer service. Work model: We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Curitiba, Paraná, Brazil . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered Solid experience in Payroll Operations with hands-on responsibility for end-to-end payroll processing. Proven expertise using TOTVS RM , particularly payroll processing, validations, reconciliations, and payroll closing activities. Advanced knowledge of payroll taxes, statutory obligations, eSocial, vacation, termination, 13th-month salary, and supplementary payroll calculations. Experience with payroll reconciliation activities and investigation of payroll discrepancies. Experience supporting multinational organizations and managing client-facing payroll activities. Knowledge of offshore payroll routines, including embarkation allowances and related payroll processes. Experience performing or validating Shadow Payroll calculations for expatriate and impatriate employees. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Availability to work in a hybrid model with 2 days per week in Curitiba. These will help you stand out Previous experience within the Offshore Oil & Gas industry. location: Sao Paulo, SP - Rochavera, Sao Paulo, Brazil
description: Job Summary Join our dynamic team as a Pharmacovigilance Analyst in the Pharma Research & Development sector. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceutical products through the monitoring, evaluation, and analysis of drug safety data. Working closely with cross-functional teams, regulatory authorities, and internal stakeholders, you will support pharmacovigilance activities and contribute to maintaining compliance with global regulatory requirements. Responsibilities Monitor and evaluate adverse event reports to ensure compliance with pharmacovigilance regulations and internal procedures. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze, interpret, and communicate safety data effectively. Prepare safety reports and support regulatory submissions in accordance with applicable guidelines and timelines. Assist in the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of pharmacovigilance systems and processes. Conduct literature reviews and surveillance activities to identify potential safety signals and emerging risks. Support PV case processing activities while ensuring data quality, accuracy, and completeness. Contribute to risk assessment and safety monitoring activities for pharmaceutical products. Maintain accurate documentation and records to support audits, inspections, and regulatory compliance. Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness. Stay current with pharmacovigilance regulations, industry trends, and best practices. Qualifications Degree in a relevant scientific discipline such as Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Medicine, Nursing, or a related field. Experience in Pharma Research & Development. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex safety data. Proficiency in pharmacovigilance data management and safety databases. Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple stakeholders. Experience in PV Case Processing. Certification in Pharmacovigilance or Drug Safety Management is preferred. Familiarity with risk management plans, safety assessments, and signal detection activities. Up-to-date knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations, guidelines, and industry standards. Ability to mentor and support junior team members. Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high-quality standards. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Work Model We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 2–3 days a week in a Cognizant office in Sao Paulo, BR . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Benefits A career in one of the largest and fastest-growing IT services providers worldwide. On

job_title: Senior BI Support Engineer (Power BI & SSRS)
location: Sao Paulo, SP - Rua Jaceru, Sao Paulo, Brazil
description: About the role As a Senior BI Support Engineer (Power BI & SSRS) , you will make an impact by providing advanced production support for reporting and analytics solutions, ensuring the stability, performance, and availability of Power BI dashboards and SSRS reports. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, data teams, and technical teams to troubleshoot complex issues, drive root cause resolution, and continuously improve reporting services. In this role, you will Provide L3 support for Power BI dashboards and SSRS reports, resolving production issues and ensuring platform stability. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents and implement permanent solutions to prevent future issues. Troubleshoot Power BI refresh failures, gateway connectivity issues, data model challenges, and performance bottlenecks. Support SSRS report administration, deployment, scheduling, subscriptions, and data source configurations. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver timely resolutions while ensuring SLA compliance and service excellence. Work Model Hybrid | São Paulo, Brazil This role follows Cognizant’s hybrid work model, requiring periodic onsite collaboration while supporting global teams and stakeholders. What you need to have to be considered Strong hands-on experience with Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service , including data modeling, DAX, and Power Query. Solid experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) , including report development, deployment, administration, and support. Strong SQL skills, including query development, stored procedures, and performance optimization. Experience with Power BI Gateway, Row-Level Security (RLS), workspace management, and application publishing. Understanding of ETL concepts, data integration, and data warehousing fundamentals. Experience working in L3 Production Support or Application Support environments. Experience with ticketing and incident management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar platforms. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Advanced English proficiency. Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. These will help you stand out Experience with Azure Analysis Services (AAS) or SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS). Knowledge of Power Automate and automation frameworks. Experience with PowerShell, Python, or other scripting languages. Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management practices. Experience supporting enterprise Business Intelligence and Analytics environments. Microsoft Power BI certifications. Please upload your resume in English Please upload your resume in English. Resumes will be reviewed by global stakeholders involved in the selection process. We're excited to meet people who share our mission.

job_title: Senior QA Analyst – Facets & Healthcare Payer
description: About the role As a Senior QA Analyst – Facets & Healthcare Payer, you will make an impact by leading quality assurance, business analysis, and test governance activities for healthcare payer solutions. You will collaborate with business, technology, and quality engineering stakeholders to strengthen test coverage, validate healthcare data, and improve testing efficiency through automation and AI-enabled capabilities. In this role, you will: Lead test planning, test management, and governance activities across healthcare payer initiatives. Analyze business requirements and translate them into test strategies, test scenarios, test cases, and validation criteria. Validate Facets functionality, healthcare payer workflows, system integrations, and underlying data. Use SQL and data-validation techniques to identify discrepancies and confirm data accuracy. Apply test automation and Gen AI capabilities to improve testing efficiency, coverage, and overall quality. Work model At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various well-being programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an onsite position in Mason, Ohio . The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations. This structure and onsite language follow the global posting template. What you need to have to be considered At least 6 + years of experience in quality assurance, business analysis, test management, or related disciplines within the healthcare payer domain . Strong hands-on knowledge of Facets , including relevant healthcare payer business processes and testing activities . Experience leading test planning, execution, defect management, reporting, and quality governance. Strong understanding of Software Development Life Cycle and Software Testing Life Cycle methodologies. Proficiency in SQL, data validation, test automation tools, and the application of Gen AI capabilities in software testing. These will help you stand out Experience using ACCELQ for test automation. Experience supporting managed vision care environments. Knowledge of healthcare payer data, integrations, and end-to-end business workflows. Ability to combine business analysis, functional testing, automation, and test governance responsibilities. Experience improving test efficiency and coverage through AI-enabled testing approaches. We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role. Benefits • Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance • Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off

location: MexicoCy,CD-Plaza Polanco, Ciudad de Mexico, Mexico
description: Job Summary Drive complex ServiceNow Now Platform initiatives as a seasoned Business Analyst with extensive experience in process analysis requirement translation and platform optimization. Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders in a hybrid work model to design scalable workflows that enhance operational efficiency and provide measurable business value while aligning with merchandising strategies where applicable. Responsibilities Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand complex operational challenges and translate them into clear ServiceNow Now Platform requirements that drive measurable efficiency gains. Analyze existing workflows and data flows on the ServiceNow Now Platform to identify gaps and recommend improvements that enhance usability reliability and end user satisfaction. Document detailed business requirements user stories and acceptance criteria for ServiceNow modules to ensure accurate configuration and successful implementation by technical teams. Coordinate with ServiceNow administrators and developers to validate solutions against requirements and ensure configurations align with enterprise standards and compliance needs. Facilitate requirement workshops discovery sessions and backlog refinement activities in a hybrid work environment to maintain alignment among business and technology teams. Evaluate current merchandising related processes where relevant and propose ServiceNow enabled enhancements that improve product lifecycle visibility and decision making quality. Monitor platform usage metrics and user feedback to identify optimization opportunities and guide continuous improvement initiatives across ServiceNow workflows and catalogs. Develop clear process maps impact assessments and business cases that demonstrate how ServiceNow enhancements support organizational objectives and deliver tangible business outcomes. Create and maintain high quality functional documentation including process narratives and configuration overviews to support knowledge transfer and long term maintainability. Support testing cycles by preparing test scenarios validating outcomes and ensuring that ServiceNow solutions meet defined quality standards before deployment in day shift operations. Collaborate with data and reporting teams to define ServiceNow reporting needs and dashboards that provide actionable insights to business stakeholders and management. Advise stakeholders on best practices for ServiceNow usage governance and request management to reduce manual effort and improve consistency across business units. Coordinate with change management teams to support communication and training efforts so that users can adopt new ServiceNow features smoothly in a hybrid work setting. Qualifications Apply extensive experience as a senior Business Analyst to guide requirement discovery stakeholder communication and documentation practices in complex enterprise environments. Utilize deep practical knowledge of the ServiceNow Now Plat

description: Cognizant is always looking for top talent. We are searching for candidates to fill future needs within the business. This job posting represents potential future employment opportunities with Cognizant. Although the position is not currently available, we want to provide you with the opportunity to express your interest in future employment opportunities with Cognizant. If a job opportunity that you may be qualified for becomes available in the future, we will notify you. At that time you can determine whether you would like to apply for the specific open position. Thank you for your interest in Cognizant career opportunities. Looking for an experienced Engineer to design, implement, and maintain payment processing systems across the LATAM region. The ideal candidate will bring deep knowledge of card payment protocols, transaction lifecycle management, and bilingual communication. Must have: Banking, Cards & Payments domain ISO 8583 (Core protocol for building and parsing financial transaction messages between payment systems. Used daily in developing, debugging, and testing card authorization and switching flows. C++, Oracle DB, Linux Payments clearing & settlement (Applied when managing end-to-end fund movement — from transaction capture through interbank clearing to final settlement. Critical for ensuring reconciliation accuracy and resolving discrepancies.) Message switching & transaction flow (Essential for designing and troubleshooting the routing logic that directs authorization requests between acquirers, issuers, and card networks. Applied in system architecture, incident resolution, and performance tuning.) Spanish (Advance), English (Intermediate) Nice to have: Card scheme certification (Advantageous when interfacing directly with Visa, Mastercard, or other scheme networks during certification and compliance testing. Reduces onboarding time and increases credibility in scheme-level discussions) Store & forward (Beneficial for handling offline transaction queuing scenarios — storing transactions locally when the network is unavailable and forwarding them once connectivity is restored. Relevant in intermittent-connectivity LATAM deployment environments.)

Job Title: Fleet Support Analyst Location: Austin, TX 78741 Pay Range: $39.46/hr. What’s the Job? Point of contact for real-time escalation of fleet issues Perform initial diagnosis and troubleshooting: Leverage your knowledge of autonomous vehicle systems, robotics, and software to quickly analyze telemetry data, identify potential root causes, and implement preliminary diagnostic procedures. Escalate unresolved issues and ensuring timely intervention by higher-level teams. Document issue resolution processes: Capture detailed records of troubleshooting steps, findings, and solutions to inform future training and system improvements. Analyze historical data and identify trends: Utilize data analytics tools to identify recurring issues, predict potential problems, and proactively implement preventive measures. Support on-call rotation with the possibility of days, swing and mid shift What’s Needed? Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to think critically under pressure. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, able to effectively communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong commitment to safety and adherence to strict quality standards. What’s in it for me? Medical, dental, vision insurance. 401 Opportunity to growth, etc!! In this role, you will: Design, develop, and support scalable data pipelines, data integrations, and processing solutions using modern cloud-native technologies. Build production-grade Python applications, scripts, and AWS Lambda functions that integrate with enterprise platforms, APIs, and AWS services. Develop and enhance data platforms leveraging technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS DMS, Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, and Snowflake. Translate business and technical requirements into engineering specifications, technical designs, and measurable acceptance criteria. Review, validate, test, debug, and optimize AI-generated code while applying engineering best practices throughout the software development lifecycle. Work model We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered Strong hands-on Python development experience with demonstrated success delivering production-quality code. Proven data engineering experience building, deploying, and supporting scalable data pipelines and processing solutions. Hands-on expertise with AWS services and cloud-native data engineering architectures. Experience working with one or more of the following technologies: AWS Glue, AWS DMS, Apache Kafka, Apache Airflow, or Snowflake. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Kiro, or similar technologies to accelerate software engineering while maintaining engineering rigor. Ability to convert business requirements into technical specifications, solution designs, and acceptance criteria. Experience reviewing, testing, debugging, and optimizing AI-generated code before production deployment. Hands-on experience developing AWS Lambda functions using Python and integrating them with AWS services. These will help you stand out Experience with Kiro, including specification-driven development approaches. Practical experience using Claude Code for software engineering or data engineering initiatives. Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and MCP-based integrations. Experience implementing automated testing

AI-Augmented Data Analyst About the role As an AI-Augmented Data Analyst , you will make an impact by transforming complex data into actionable insights that support better decision-making across underwriting, claims, finance, and operational functions. You will be a valued member of the Data & Analytics team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, data engineers, and technology partners to deliver advanced analytics solutions that improve business outcomes, operational efficiency, and customer experiences. This role combines traditional analytics expertise with emerging AI-assisted analytical techniques to accelerate insight generation while maintaining the highest standards of accuracy, governance, and data quality. In this role, you will: Develop and optimize analytical solutions using Snowflake SQL and modern data analysis tools to support enterprise reporting and decision-making. Perform exploratory data analysis on large structured and semi-structured datasets to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers. Build and maintain analytical datasets, data marts, and reporting assets that support business intelligence and advanced analytics initiatives. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate business questions into measurable analytical solutions and actionable recommendations. Apply AI-augmented analytics techniques to improve data exploration, pattern recognition, and insight generation while ensuring results are accurate, transparent, and business-relevant. Develop reports, dashboards, visualizations, and presentations that communicate complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Implement data quality controls, validation routines, and reconciliation processes to maintain trusted analytical assets. Document business rules, data lineage, analytical methodologies, and reporting logic to support governance and knowledge sharing. Partner with data engineering teams to improve data availability, integration, performance, and analytic readiness. Support ad hoc analytical requests related to portfolio performance, operational effectiveness, customer behavior, and business strategy. Promote responsible, ethical, and compliant use of data and AI-assisted analytics technologies. Work model We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants within the Eastern Time Zone (EST) . While Hartford, CT is the preferred location, qualified remote candidates located within EST will also be considered. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. The professional will work from office in a day shift collaborating with product and engineering partners to deliver scalable data solutions that improve decision making and support innovative digital services for global stakeholders. Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

job_title: Data Engineer – Snowflake / Apache Iceberg / Python
description: Job Responsibilities Design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions to support PIPL program requirements. Build and maintain end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, and modern data engineering frameworks. Develop and manage data lakehouse architectures using Apache Iceberg and Snowflake. Create and support a dedicated China data environment on Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud) for data processing, analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. Automate data ingestion, transformation, validation, and reporting processes to improve operational efficiency. Optimize data pipelines, storage, and query performance to ensure scalability and reliability. Collaborate with architects, program leads, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data solutions. Ensure data quality, governance, security, and compliance with PIPL and enterprise standards. Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data platform and pipeline issues. Contribute to best practices in DataOps, CI/CD, automation, and cloud-native data engineering. Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Big Data environments. Strong hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg. Proven experience working with Snowflake for data warehousing and analytics. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL development. Experience designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions. Solid understanding of data lake, lakehouse, and data warehouse architectures. Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud). Knowledge of distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks. Experience with data modeling, performance tuning, and data quality management. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and automation tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Experience in regulatory or data privacy-focused environments (PIPL/GDPR) is an added advantage. #LI-CTSAPAC

location: Peoria, IL -Washington St, Illinois, United States
description: About the role As a Data Strategy & Data Governance Consultant , you will make an impact by driving enterprise data initiatives that improve data quality, governance, analytics enablement, and business decision-making. You will be a valued member of the Data Strategy team and work collaboratively with business stakeholders, dealers, technology teams, data architects, and governance organizations to maximize the value of enterprise and dealer data assets. This role combines data strategy, data governance, business engagement, data modeling, and analytics enablement to ensure high-quality, trusted data is available to support critical business operations and strategic initiatives. In this role, you will: Partner with business stakeholders, dealers, and technical teams to identify, document, and prioritize data use cases that deliver measurable business value. Facilitate requirements gathering sessions and translate business needs into data strategies, governance standards, and analytical solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop analytics, integrations, and business applications leveraging enterprise data assets. Design and maintain logical and physical data models supporting enterprise data management and analytics initiatives. Develop and maintain data dictionaries, metadata repositories, data lineage documentation, interface specifications, and knowledge management assets. Define and implement enterprise data governance standards, policies, and change management processes. Establish and promote data quality frameworks, validation standards, stewardship processes, and monitoring practices. Develop SQL queries and perform source-to-target data validation to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness of enterprise data. Conduct data quality assessments and maturity evaluations while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement. Partner with business and technical leadership to resolve data issues, align on data standards, and support enterprise data strategy initiatives. Prepare executive-level presentations and recommendations that communicate business value, data insights, and governance outcomes. Support a globally distributed stakeholder community, including occasional early morning or evening collaboration sessions. Work model We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring time in a Cognizant or client office as determined by project and business needs. job_title: Data Quality Engineer - Remote in Canada
location: Halifax,NS-6940 Mumford Rd, Nova Scotia, Canada
description: Data Quality Engineer As a Data Quality Engineer specializing in Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity at Cognizant, you will design and execute automated data validation across extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes, data warehouses, and data migrations. You will work with development and data engineering teams to verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source and target systems. This is a full-time, remote role open only to candidates located in Canada. In this role, you will Review business requirements, source-to-target mappings, and ETL designs to identify test scenarios and prepare test plans and cases. Design and execute ETL, data warehouse, and data migration tests, including automated data validation scripts using Tosca Data Integrity. Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Perform source-to-target reconciliation and data integrity checks, using SQL queries to validate transformations and load processes. Log, track, and retest defects in partnership with development and data engineering teams. Collaborate with onshore and offshore teams to deliver testing activities and prepare test execution reports and knowledge-transfer documentation. Provide regular status updates, identify risks, and support production validation activities. What you need to have to be considered 6+ years of overall experience in software testing, ETL testing, and data validation, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity. Strong experience in ETL, data warehouse, and data migration testing, including validation across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Hands-on SQL query writing and database testing experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or DB2. Strong understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation, and data integrity testing. Ability to analyze business requirements, data models, mapping documents, and technical specifications and translate them into test plans and test cases. Experience with test execution and defect management using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments and an onshore-offshore delivery model, with effective cross-functional collaboration. Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with clear verbal and written communication. These will help you stand out Insurance domain experience. Experience with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Snowflake. Knowledge of data lake and big data testing. Experience with Informatica, DataStage, SSIS, Talend, or other ETL tools. Tosca Automation Certification. Why Apply? We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed.

job_title: GenAI Architect – Generative AI & Agentic AI
location: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States; Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
description: About the role: As a GenAI Architect, you will make an impact by designing and delivering enterprise-scale Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions that accelerate business innovation and transform software engineering practices. You will be a valued member of our AI and Architecture team and collaborate closely with application engineering, cloud, data, security, DevOps, and business stakeholders to bring AI solutions from concept through production deployment. In this role, you will: Architect and deliver scalable Generative AI, LLM, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions for enterprise applications. Design and build AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, orchestration workflows, reusable services, APIs, and accelerators. Develop architecture patterns for prompt engineering, context management, grounding, guardrails, model evaluation, and structured outputs. Lead the adoption of AI-assisted software engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and similar platforms to improve developer productivity and software quality. Establish best practices for responsible AI, LLMOps, observability, security, governance, CI/CD, and production monitoring while mentoring engineering teams and driving enterprise AI standards. Work model: We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Charlotte, NC. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered: 10+ years of experience in solution architecture, application architecture, software engineering, AI/ML, or related technology disciplines. Hands-on experience architecting and delivering enterprise Generative AI and LLM-based applications. Proven experience building AI agents, copilots, RAG solutions, and LLM-powered workflows. Strong knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies, agent orchestration, and model evaluation. Experience with AWS cloud services, preferably Amazon Bedrock, and cloud-native application architectures. Expertise with APIs, microservices, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and distributed systems. Strong understanding of AI security, responsible AI, governance, observability, and production monitoring. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business teams. These will help you stand out: Experience with Palantir, enterprise AI platforms, vector databases, or enterprise knowledge management platforms. Experien

Job summary Sr Business Analyst role focused on analyzing complex business processes translating stakeholder needs into clear requirements and driving impactful solutions that align with organizational strategy. The role involves hybrid work with day shifts collaborating across teams to improve performance optimize operations and enable data informed decisions while ensuring consistent delivery quality and sustainable value. Responsibilities Analyze diverse business processes and stakeholder objectives to identify improvement opportunities that enhance operational efficiency and support strategic organizational goals. Collaborate with cross functional teams to gather detailed business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide solution design and implementation. Document current and future state workflows with precise process maps and narratives that help stakeholders understand impacts dependencies and required changes. Evaluate potential solution options using structured analysis techniques and recommend approaches that balance business value feasibility and long term sustainability. Facilitate requirement walkthroughs and feedback sessions with stakeholders to confirm shared understanding resolve ambiguities and secure alignment on scope and priorities. Support development and configuration activities by clarifying requirements answering business context questions and validating proposed technical designs against business needs. Design comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance criteria that verify end to end coverage of requirements and enable robust user acceptance testing outcomes. Analyze data and performance metrics from implemented solutions to measure value realization identify gaps or issues and propose improvements that refine business outcomes. Prepare clear status reports and analytic summaries that communicate progress risks and insights to stakeholders in a concise and actionable format. Coordinate hybrid working interactions by planning onsite and remote collaboration sessions that maintain productivity inclusiveness and timely decision making. Ensure compliance with internal standards and industry regulations in all analysis deliverables so that solutions are secure ethical and aligned to societal expectations. Contribute to knowledge sharing by creating reusable templates guidelines and best practice documentation that strengthen the business analysis capability across the company. Partner with business and technology teams to ensure that implemented solutions improve customer and employee experiences and positively impact broader communities. Qualifications Apply deep business analysis expertise gained from eight to ten years of experience to interpret complex stakeholder needs and convert them into structured requirements. Demonstrate strong proficiency in business analysis practices and business analysis and planning disciplines such as process modeling requirements elicitation and impac

Required Skills Workday Functional Skills Strong understanding of Workday Financial Management modules. Experience in testing Workday Finance implementations or support projects. Knowledge of Workday business processes and security configurations. Understanding of financial accounting principles and ERP processes. Testing Skills Functional Testing System Integration Testing (SIT) Regression Testing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) End-to-End Testing Defect Management Test Planning & Execution #LI-SN3
